records.name: Permitted component fleet lists

source.title: A Call to Arms: Second Edition Fleet Lists
source.section: Combined Fleets of the Non-Aligned Worlds

records.summary: An Allied League fleet may draw ships only from the listed League, Raiders, and selected Other Ships lists.
records.remedy_hint: Remove ships from an unlisted fleet list.

records.name: No cross-fleet carrier loading

source.title: A Call to Arms: Second Edition Fleet Lists
source.section: Combined Fleets of the Non-Aligned Worlds

records.summary: Fighters from one component fleet list may not be placed in a carrier from another component fleet list.
records.remedy_hint: Return the craft to a carrier from its own fleet list or restore the carrier's standard craft.

records.name: Ship prerequisite for purchased fighters

source.title: A Call to Arms: Second Edition Fleet Lists
source.section: Combined Fleets of the Non-Aligned Worlds

records.summary: Separately purchased fighters require at least one ship from the same component fleet list.
records.remedy_hint: Add a ship from the fighter's fleet list or remove the purchased fighter wing.

records.name: Combined League date limit

source.title: Powers & Principalities
source.section: Combined League Fleets and Army of Light

records.summary: Combined League fleets may include only ships whose In Service Date extends no later than 2259.
records.remedy_hint: Choose ships valid for 2259 or earlier, or use an Army of Light fleet for a later battle.

records.name: Permitted fleet lists
records.summary: Army of Light fleets may draw only from the published list of member fleet lists.
records.remedy_hint: Remove ships from an unlisted fleet list.

records.name: Permitted platforms
records.summary: Only the specifically listed ships, fighters, and variants may be selected.
records.remedy_hint: Replace the platform with one named in the Army of Light roster.

records.name: Minimum two component fleets
records.summary: An Army of Light must include ships from at least two different fleet lists.
records.remedy_hint: Add a qualifying ship from a second permitted fleet list.

records.name: Allied contingent

source.title: A Call to Arms: Second Edition Fleet Lists
source.section: ISA Fleet Special Rules - Allied Fleets

records.summary: Up to one scenario-level FAP may be spent on one permitted allied fleet list.
records.remedy_hint: Reduce allied expenditure, or remove ships from additional allied fleet lists.

records.name: Fleet unavailable before 2262

source.title: A Call to Arms: Second Edition Fleet Lists
source.section: ISA Fleet Special Rules - In Service Dates

records.summary: The ISA fleet list may not be used in scenarios set before 2262.
records.remedy_hint: Set the scenario year to 2262 or later, or choose another fleet list.

records.name: Allied contingent

source.title: A Call to Arms: Second Edition Fleet Lists
source.section: Raiders Fleet Special Rules - Allied Fleets

records.summary: Up to one scenario-level FAP may be spent on one permitted League allied fleet list.
records.remedy_hint: Reduce allied expenditure, or remove ships from additional allied fleet lists.

records.name: EarthForce requisition

source.title: A Call to Arms: Second Edition Fleet Lists
source.section: Psi Corps Fleet Special Rules - EarthForce Requisition

records.summary: Up to two scenario-level FAP may be spent on ships from one Earth Alliance fleet list.
records.remedy_hint: Reduce Earth Alliance expenditure to the permitted allowance.

records.name: At least one Queen

source.title: Powers & Principalities
source.section: Revised Gaim Intelligence Fleet Special Rules - The Queens

records.summary: Every revised Gaim fleet must contain at least one Queen ship.
records.remedy_hint: Add any Queen ship or remove all non-Queen choices and rebuild the fleet.

records.name: One highest-priority Ruling Queen

source.title: Powers & Principalities
source.section: Revised Gaim Intelligence Fleet Special Rules - The Queens

records.summary: Only one Queen of the highest Priority Level represented in the fleet may be present; lower-priority Queens are unrestricted.
records.remedy_hint: Remove duplicate Queens at the fleet's highest represented Queen priority.

records.name: Each Ancient is unique

source.title: A Call to Arms: Second Edition Fleet Lists

records.summary: Only one example of each Ancient platform may be selected.
records.remedy_hint: Reduce the fleet to one copy of each Ancient platform.

records.name: Ancients depart in 2261

source.title: A Call to Arms: Second Edition Fleet Lists

records.summary: The five Ancient vessels disappear during the early part of 2261.
records.remedy_hint: Use the fleet only in a suitably dated special scenario.
records.notes: The text is narrative rather than a precise month boundary; activation should present an advisory unless scenario metadata is expanded.

records.name: Huge Hangar carried-ship capacity

source.title: A Call to Arms: Second Edition Fleet Lists
source.section: Drakh Fleet Special Rules - Huge Hangars

records.summary: Light Raiders, Heavy Raiders, and Scouts consume Huge Hangar slots; larger Amu-carried ships consume two or eight slots as printed.
records.remedy_hint: Reduce carried craft or replace them with craft that fit the remaining Huge Hangar capacity.
